title: Construction in Garabito, Costa Rica | MA Soluciones
description: Construction services across Garabito, Costa Rica: building, remodeling and maintenance for Jacó, Herradura, Playa Hermosa and the whole canton.
ogTitle: Construction Services in Garabito | MA Soluciones Integrales
h1: Construction Services in Garabito and the Central Pacific
lead: We build, remodel and maintain properties across the canton of Garabito — Jacó, Herradura and Playa Hermosa — with site visits scheduled from our local base.

faqs.q: Do you serve all of Garabito, not just Jacó?
faqs.a: Yes. We cover the whole canton, including Herradura, Playa Hermosa and surrounding beach communities, with scheduled site visits coordinated from our base in Jacó.

faqs.q: Do you help with municipal permits in Garabito?
faqs.a: We manage the paperwork with the Municipality of Garabito, including construction permits, ICE inspections and CFIA approvals, so your project is fully compliant from start to finish.

faqs.q: What warranty do you offer in Garabito?
faqs.a: All work is guaranteed: from 3 months for repairs to 24 months for major works. We use certified materials suited to the saline coastal air of the Central Pacific.
